content: {"summary":"Customers report frequent driver‑cancelled trips causing unjust charges, often with no refund and poor support response [tk_2253925][tk_344661][tk_2732985]. Many are charged high cancellation fees ($5–$10) or even full fares after the driver leaves the vehicle, with disputes denied or ignored [tk_134465][tk_2414670][tk_1843757]. Users demand refunds directly to their bank accounts and better communication from Uber to resolve these incidents [tk_948014][tk_2762965]"}
